gateway:prepareAgentWirePayload:text.note: the gateway rebuilds `text` per item when the emitter sent only a delta: the assistant text is cumulative PER ITEM upstream (server-chat-live-text.ts prepareAgentWirePayload: a new itemId restarts it); the normalizer applies each `text` as the whole bubble's snapshot, so a second item shrinks the bubble and Convex refuses it (snapshot_regression) until the chat stream repairs it

gateway:mergeAgentTextPayload:delta.by: a coalesced delta is one longer delta: the append path and the live-text baseline read it like any other

proof.note: coalescing depends on delivery timing; the merged shape is pinned in the baseline suite

bus:enrichAgentEvent:completionSource.why: which completion path settled the run, not part of a turn's outcome in Atrium; not read; no reader of it under ui/src either at this tag

bus:enrichAgentEvent:startedAt.why: run timing: Atrium times a turn on its own clock
